subject.title: [Bug]: Browser interactions can exhaust model context by injecting too much page content

question: Should omitted/default browser reads become compact and goal-shaped, and what explicit raw/full snapshot escape hatch should remain?
rationale: Current code has partial caps and efficient-mode knobs, but choosing default model-facing browser semantics and compatibility boundaries requires maintainer product direction.

options.title: Default Compact Browser Reads
options.body: Make omitted browser reads compact and goal-shaped by default, preserve explicit raw/full snapshot modes, and add compact post-action change reports.

options.title: Action Diffs First
options.body: Keep snapshot defaults unchanged for now but add compact post-action change reports to reduce repeated snapshots during multi-step workflows.

options.title: Keep Opt-In Efficient Mode
options.body: Leave current defaults in place and document `browser.snapshotDefaults.mode: "efficient"` plus raw `maxChars` controls as the supported mitigation.

recommendation.title: Default Compact Browser Reads
recommendation.body: Make omitted browser reads compact and goal-shaped by default, preserve explicit raw/full snapshot modes, and add compact post-action change reports.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest browser plugin ownership and snapshot-default history among the likely owners.
